artists.biography: Pop Will Eat Itself (also known as PWEI or The Poppies) are an English alternative rock band, originally formed in Stourbridge in 1986, with members from Birmingham, Coventry and the Black Country. Initially known as a Grebo act, their style changed to incorporate sample driven indie and industrial rock. Their highest charting single was 1993's "Get The Girl! Kill The Baddies!". After initially disbanding in 1996, and having a brief reformation in 2005, they issued their first release in over five years in 2010.

perplexity.description:
X Y & Zee" is a single by Pop Will Eat Itself, originally released in January 1991 on RCA Records. Musically, it exemplifies the band's signature fusion of electronic and rock elements, blending driving beats, industrial textures, and catchy guitar riffs with a distinct sense of irony and wit. The track stands out for its energetic production and danceable rhythm, reflecting the band's ability to merge alternative rock with electronic dance music—a hallmark of their early 1990s output.

The single was taken from the album Cure for Sanity (1990), which marked a pivotal moment in Pop Will Eat Itself's discography, solidifying their reputation as innovators in the UK alternative scene. "X Y & Zee" became the band's highest-charting single from that album, reaching No. 15 on the UK Singles Chart and achieving notable success in the United States, where it spent 16 weeks on the Billboard Alternative Songs chart, peaking at No. 11. Its commercial performance and critical acclaim helped cement Pop Will Eat Itself's status as a leading act in the crossover between rock and electronic music during the early 1990s.
